summary: Console: conditional metric rename causes dashboard tiles to render empty series for org-specific groupings
description: Issue summary: After an org-scoped backfill (2026-03-11) for Finlytics, several dashboard tiles that group by 'environment' and display the metric 'requests.total' rendered as empty series for that org. Impact: customer-facing dashboards show 0 or blank lines for historical ranges, causing alarm fatigue and confusion. Behavior appears after a conditional metric rename was applied in the ingestion pipeline where 'requests.total' was aliased to 'req_count' only for orgs that opted into a legacy-migration flag. This rename interacted poorly with the rollup backfill, resulting in time-series rows that couldn't be joined to dashboard groupby keys.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Org Finlytics has legacy-migration flag enabled in org settings
2) Trigger or simulate a historical rollup/backfill for the org for range 2026-03-01..2026-03-10
3) Open an existing dashboard with a panel that queries metric 'requests.total' grouped by 'environment' and span 7-14 days
4) Observe that the panel shows empty series (no points) for the Finlytics org while other orgs display expected series
5) Query raw timeseries in metrics explorer for 'req_count' and 'requests.total' scoped to Finlytics to see mismatched row keys
logs: ingestion-rollup-worker us-east-3 logs (2026-03-11T02:14:22Z): INFO backfill started for org=finlytics range=2026-03-01..2026-03-10
metrics-transformer (2026-03-11T02:14:27Z): DEBUG applied conditional alias: requests.total -> req_count for org=finlytics
rollup-joiner (2026-03-11T03:01:05Z): WARN unmatched-groupkey: metric=requests.total groupby=environment key=prod org=finlytics shard=12
dashboard-renderer (2026-03-12T09:45:13Z): ERROR series-join-failed: panel=panel-97 query=SELECT... cause=missing-timeseries-rows
comments: Maya Thompson (Support) 2026-03-12: Customer reported multiple dashboard panels showing blank series after historical reload. Provided initial screenshots and panel JSON.
Finlytics-SE (customer) 2026-03-12: Confirmed dashboards were OK before the backfill. We saw the backfill run on 2026-03-11. Attached query logs and example panel IDs.

Diego Morales (SRE) 2026-03-13: Reproduced in staging by toggling the legacy-migration flag and running a small-range backfill. Observed alias applied during transform stage; rollup join did not normalize alias back to canonical metric name for groupby keys.

Diego Morales (SRE) 2026-03-14: Opened PR to add canonicalization step in rollup-joiner to map aliased metric names to canonical names before the groupby join. Leaving open while we run a targeted backfill patch.

Maya Thompson (Support) 2026-03-14: Notified customer that we plan a hotfix backfill in us-east on 2026-03-15 with a rollback window. Asked customer for low-traffic maintenance window (02:00-04:00 UTC).
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: Conditional aliasing in metrics-transformer created a new metric key (req_count) while historical rollup code expects the canonical key (requests.total). The joiner uses metric name + groupby hash to rehydrate series; mismatch caused rows to be orphaned.
Confirmed that the alias is only applied when org.legacy_migration=true. Only Finlytics and one internal test org were affected in us-east.
Query of raw index shows presence of both 'req_count' and 'requests.total' rows for different ingest windows; timestamps align but groupby hash values differ.

Temporary mitigation tested: run a normalization pass in rollup-joiner to map 'req_count' -> 'requests.total' during backfill. This fixes join for test data but needs careful validation to avoid double-counting when both metrics legitimately exist.
Risk assessment: normalization could cause collisions if customer legitimately reports both metric names. Need to rely on org-scoped alias metadata to make transformation safe.
Related anomalies: console alert FIN-DASH-CPU spike occurred around same backfill window but appears unrelated (heavy backfill load).
resolution: Workaround: Support updated the affected dashboards to use a metrics-explorer union query (requests.total OR req_count) to surface historical points for Finlytics while fix is prepared.
Fix planned: Deploy rollup-joiner normalization patch that references org-scoped alias mapping so aliased metrics are canonicalized during backfill. PR opened and under review (ingestion PR #1289).
Backfill plan: Run targeted corrective backfill for org=finlytics in us-east on 2026-03-15 02:30 UTC. Post-backfill validation will compare panel snapshots vs baseline and run alert smoke-tests.
Follow-up: Add regression test to CI to cover conditional-alias + backfill workflow and add a dashboard-level lint that warns when a panel references a metric that has an active org alias.
